notes: Observational configurable rules for HC-301. Thresholds require clinician review. No treatment or insulin dosing advice.
safety_disclaimer: Observational only — not a diagnosis. Does not replace FreeStyle Libre alarms, Samsung Health Monitor, medical care, or emergency services.

rules.title: Low glucose
rules.recommended_next_step: Review glucose reading and follow your clinician-approved hypoglycemia plan. Manufacturer CGM alarms must remain enabled.

rules.title: Very low glucose
rules.recommended_next_step: Treat per clinician-approved plan and seek urgent medical care if needed. This app does not replace emergency services.

rules.title: High glucose
rules.recommended_next_step: Review recent meals, medication timing, and CGM/meter confirmation with your care plan. No dosing advice is provided.

rules.title: Rapidly falling glucose
rules.recommended_next_step: Check current glucose and follow clinician-approved guidance. Keep manufacturer alarms enabled.

rules.title: Rapidly rising glucose
rules.recommended_next_step: Note meal/activity context and confirm with your usual monitoring routine.

rules.title: Glucose data gap
rules.recommended_next_step: Confirm sensor/reader connectivity or enter a confirmed reading. No data is never treated as normal.

rules.title: CGM sensor expiring
rules.recommended_next_step: Prepare a replacement sensor and confirm inventory before expiry.

rules.title: CGM sensor expired
rules.recommended_next_step: Replace the sensor per manufacturer instructions and update the sensor registry.

rules.title: CGM reserve below minimum
rules.recommended_next_step: Reorder sensors to restore the protected reserve. Confirm inventory manually.

rules.title: CGM projected coverage shortfall
rules.recommended_next_step: Reorder promptly; projected coverage is below configured buffer needs.

rules.title: Elevated resting heart rate
rules.recommended_next_step: Review context (illness, activity, medication). Wearable HR is observational.

rules.title: Unusually low resting heart rate
rules.recommended_next_step: If symptomatic, seek medical care. Observational wearable reading only.

rules.title: Low oxygen saturation
rules.recommended_next_step: Confirm with a validated pulse oximeter if available and seek care if symptomatic.

rules.title: Elevated blood pressure
rules.recommended_next_step: Samsung BP is user-initiated, not continuous. Follow clinician guidance for repeat checks.

rules.title: Unusually low blood pressure
rules.recommended_next_step: If dizzy or unwell, seek medical care. Observational only.

rules.title: Repeated abnormal measurements
rules.recommended_next_step: Review recent confirmed readings with your clinician-approved plan.

rules.title: Worsening multi-day trend
rules.recommended_next_step: Trend is observational; discuss persistent changes with your clinician.

rules.title: Glucose outside personal baseline band
rules.recommended_next_step: Value is outside your personal rolling band when baseline is ready. Not a diagnosis.

rules.title: Monitoring pipeline failure
rules.recommended_next_step: Retry evaluation or re-import the latest confirmed record. Background PWA checks are not guaranteed.
